text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Ghh!
Dammit, dammit, dammit, DAMMIIIT...!!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Haaah...
This is my first dream of the year?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Guess I got no choice.
Time to sort the data.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
—2:02.0, 2:01.3, 2:00.7...
We have plenty of data on firm turf.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Guess I should log some more heavy and yielding turf practice.
Maybe request the sprinklers to up the moisture level...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...
Will we make it in time with this?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Shall I enter?

text_block_list.name: TV Noise
text_block_list.text:
"—3, 2, 1!
Happy New Yeeeaaar!"
"While making preparations for the Classic Year, the New Year arrived before I even knew it."
choice_data_list: (Maybe I'll take a walk for a change of pace.)

text_block_list.text:
Thinking that, when I left the Academy late at night...
I spotted the silhouette of a student about to head out?!
And what's more—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Tch...

Tracen Academy has a curfew.
Being outside at this hour is completely out of the question...
Once you step outside the dorms, there's no making excuses.
choice_data_list: Where were you planning on going?
Where were you trying to go?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: A walk.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, I get it.
So what about it?
choice_data_list: You usually follow the rules, right?
You usually follow the rules, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I'm just weighing the pros and cons.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Nobody's lookin' right now.
If you turn on your heels, this whole thing's over...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"You've done more than enough for them.
Turn back now."
With the Classic Year finally approaching, perhaps she was feeling a bit tense.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I know you hear me.
I said you're in the damn way.
Curfew exists to protect the students. I don't want to restrict Air Shakur's actions, but I have to stop her here.
If I'm going to hold her back to the point of asking her to suppress her feelings, I need to present a convincing advantage greater than what she has now...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...
Like what?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Then no deal.
There ain't a damn thing I want from you.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Negotiations failed.
See ya.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: If you want to make a deal, bring the materials.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Otherwise,
I wouldn't even bother sitting at the table.

Air Shakur is right.
As for the best bargaining chip
we can offer on our end...
choice_data_list: Who should we give the trainer's office to?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh?

Air Shakur wants to go somewhere quiet right now.
At this hour, there's no one in the Trainer's Office,
let alone the academy grounds.
choice_data_list: It's still safer inside the academy grounds, after all.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Where are the security guards?
choice_data_list: I'll talk to them in advance.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
So, you're gonna go somewhere else, right?
Don't go telling me you're gonna keep watch.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...If you're seriously not around.

I won't put them under surveillance. But just in case, I need to keep watch.
Until safety is assured, I'll secretly keep an eye out from a distance...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...So, in the end,
you really did just conk out, huh."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Haaah... Ridiculous.

The next morning, when I woke up... Air Shakur was
gone, and the jacket I'd left in the Trainer's office
was draped over my head.

...Maybe because I've been working up to this hour, my brain isn't working at all!
And so, the words that slipped out of my mouth were—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Haaah~?
choice_data_list: Don't go... I don't want you to!!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Whoa, whoa, of all the things you could've said...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Hm?
You're...

Air Shakur stares intently at me...
After a brief moment—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm fine.
I'm going to sleep now."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"You hurry on home and go to bed too.
And also..."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Spending more time ain't gonna fix everything.
If your workload's screwed up, adjust it first.
If you can't simplify it, change your method.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The moment you start convincing yourself you're "working hard,"
it's over.
Quit before that happens.

...It seems they saw right through me.
I decided to just go home obediently and sleep.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...
You sure look unusually lively.
choice_data_list: I feel so much better after a good night's sleep, thank you!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you ashamed of yourself,
thankin' me for somethin' like that?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Whatever. Let's get right to training. Time's not gonna wait for us.

I'll have to put some real thought into this.
Air Shakur is the type to perceive even 'blank space'
as information. In that case...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: The moment you overlook it right now, it becomes your responsibility.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Well, if you insist.

Fighting the urge to stop him, I watch Air Shakur's retreating back...
Five more steps, four, three, two, one—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Fine, spill it.
What're you schemin'?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
They got me.
Were they really not thinking anything at all?!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...*sigh*
I've lost the mood. I'm going home.
choice_data_list: Ah! If you need a change of pace...

text_block_list.text:
I bought a bunch of new convenience store snacks to keep us going during overtime.
Thinking there might be something she likes, I handed over the whole bag.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I don't waaant it...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hm? ...Candy toys from "LF"?
Was that game really that popular?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
—Huh... that's super detailed.
...Should I put it on my desk?
